# Preview env keys permitted to carry real (non-blank) values into the
# untrusted preview build job. One key per line, `#` comments allowed.
#
# Seeded 2026-10-01 from the live Preview inventory, MINUS the privileged
# keys the redact step blanks (see preview-env-redact.sed): only
# identifiers, endpoints, and platform plumbing remain. NEXT_PUBLIC_*
# keys need no entry (public by definition) and blank assignments need
# none (sensitive-marked keys arrive blank).
#
# Adding a name here is a conscious decision that branch builds may read
# the real Preview value. Prefer marking the key sensitive in Vercel
# instead; only allowlist values the build genuinely needs. Any new
# non-blank server key fails the workflow until it is allowlisted here
# with review, marked sensitive, or added to the redact patterns.
